settings.tagline: Heaven sent. Hell on your personal space. The official society for soft hearts in heavy armor.

settings.eyebrow: The four laws of the pack

settings.title: Stay soft
settings.body: Tenderness is a weapon. Refuse to apologize for it.

settings.title: Stay feral
settings.body: The internet wants a lone wolf. We are the pack.

settings.title: Wear the armor
settings.body: Heavyweight cotton. Distressed graphics. Built to outlive your worst week.

settings.title: Take the nap
settings.body: Rest is rebellion. Lie down often. Dream meaner.

settings.heading: In the wild
settings.body: The pack, photographed in their natural habitat: soft hearts, hard mornings, longer walks than expected.
Membership is free. Initiation is automatic. The first time you put it on, you're in.
